_meta.note: Hand-maintained static reference data, NOT generated by the pipeline -- unlike every other file in this directory, this does not update automatically. Update manually if TC Energy republishes rates.
_meta.units: cents per GJ per day (Cdn), the 'information purposes' column in the source, used here because it's the one common unit across receipt (normally $/10^3 m3/mo) and delivery (normally $/GJ/mo) rate structures

ft_r_range.note: FT-R is receipt-point specific and negotiated within this range; 27.7 shown above is the system average demand rate, not this range's midpoint.
